label: JOKE first-class humor-frame routing
description: First-class reusable µ-track for humor-frame routing, ambiguity permission, delivery-frame folds, pun bridges, metaphor routing, and punchline-compatible sense collapse. It does not perform freeform joke authorship.

folds.responsibility: Open the premise/frame without selecting a surface topic as the domain.
Bind context and select the expected route while preserving role structure.
Execute the resolution and verify structural closure.
Treat anti-jokes, meta-jokes, and bait-and-switch endings as declared variants, not failures.

boundary_rules.rule: Frames are declared, not inferred from token co-occurrence.
Beats are phase-typed before they are accepted as folds.
Roles bind to schema slots; surface tokens only fill or alias those slots.
Ch'en verifies resolved, subverted, or failed collapse structurally.
Subversion is a declared variant, not an exception.
Frequent token associations do not become frames without manifest declaration.

phase_route.operation: bind role slots and surface aliases
commit selected semantic key plus rendered surface

can: keep multiple senses active inside JOKE policy
map declared aliases to frame roles
preserve surface answer text separately from semantic key
cannot: promote raw token co-occurrence into a frame
treat analogy overlay as selected domain without frame evidence
